info.name: College ERP — Full API Collection
info.description: Complete collection covering every REST endpoint in the College ERP backend (44 controllers, all modules). Run 'Login' first — it auto-captures accessToken/refreshToken/userId into collection variables. Most 'create' requests auto-capture the created resource's id into a matching collection variable (e.g. creating a Department sets {{departmentId}}), so you can usually run requests top-to-bottom within a folder without manually copying UUIDs. Requires a running instance against a real PostgreSQL database (see CLAUDE.md) — set {{baseUrl}} to match (default http://localhost:8080).
